observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera with 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 650D' model name visible on the top right. The lens has 'Canon' and focal length markings (18-55mm).
Photo 1: Rear view showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, INFO, WB, SET, AF), and the rear grip. The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs.

Photo 2: Top view showing the mode dial, shutter button, and flash sync button. The lens barrel has '18-55mm' and 'STABILIZER ON' visible. The camera body shows signs of use, including minor scratches and wear on the grip area.
All photos show the camera held in hand against a plain white background. No accessories (battery, charger, strap) are visible.
The seller claims it is 'UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM Lens Working perfectly ok with No...' — the 'No...' is cut off.

claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM Lens
claims.evidence: The model name 'EOS 650D' is visible in photo 0 and photo 2, and the lens is 18-55mm as seen in photo 0 and photo 2. However, 'UK Used' and 'Clean and Sharp' are subjective and not verifiable from photos alone. 'Working perfectly ok' is unverifiable_remote.
No video or photo shows the camera powered on, taking a photo, or any functional test. The shutter button and mode dial appear intact, but no proof of operation is provided.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the LCD screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus (especially at the front element)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light, or a video showing the lens being focused and the image quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: Camera body may have hidden damage (e.g., cracked sensor, internal dust, or water damage)
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body with the LCD screen off, showing the sensor and internal components, or a video of the camera being opened and closed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body may have hidden damage

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing the battery being inserted and the camera powering on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger may be missing

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the LCD screen.
Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light to check for fungus or damage.
Photo of the camera body with the LCD screen off, showing the sensor and internal components.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
